vBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup
vBRIEFInfo.description: Phase 5 — Polish, documentation, and npm publish

narrative.Summary: Final polish pass before the first npm release: complete README with API reference and usage examples (voice/video/agent-bridge), fill CHANGELOG with v0.1.0 entry, configure npm publish (provenance, access:public, .npmignore), run npm publish dry-run to verify the package output, and confirm importability from a test consumer. Conventional Commits enforced throughout.
narrative.Acceptance: npm publish --dry-run exits 0. Package tarball contains dist/, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE. A minimal test consumer (test/consumer/index.ts) imports @openclaw/voice-sdk and types resolve correctly. README explains 'voice in the telecom sense' and documents VoiceProvider, Call, AgentBridge, MockVoiceProvider, WhatsAppVoiceProvider APIs with code examples.
narrative.Dependencies: All prior scopes (scaffold, types, mock, whatsapp, cli) must be complete.

items.title: README.md — complete API documentation
items.narrative: Sections: About (telecom-sense note, voice/video/screen/data), Install, Quick Start (incoming call with MockProvider + AgentBridge), API Reference (VoiceProvider, Call, AgentBridge, MediaSource, CallOptions, CallError), Provider Guide (WhatsAppVoiceProvider + DI setup), Testing Guide (MockVoiceProvider usage), Contributing.

items.title: CHANGELOG.md — v0.1.0 entry
items.narrative: Follow Keep a Changelog format. v0.1.0 entry: Added VoiceProvider/Call/AgentBridge interfaces, MockVoiceProvider, WhatsAppVoiceProvider (DI), BaseAgentBridge, CLI harness, CallError, MediaService. Note telecom-sense naming.

items.title: npm publish configuration
items.narrative: .npmignore: exclude src/, test/, vbrief/, directive/, *.config.ts, Taskfile.yml. package.json: publishConfig.access=public, provenance if using npm provenance. Add task release to Taskfile: runs task check, then npm publish --dry-run (gate requiring --live flag to actually publish).

items.title: test/consumer/index.ts — import smoke test
items.narrative: Minimal file: import { MockVoiceProvider, type Call, type VoiceProvider } from '@openclaw/voice-sdk'. Compile this file against the published dist/ to verify type declarations resolve. Run as part of task check via tsc --noEmit.
